source.quote: `gh api --paginate --jq '[.[].name]'` emits one JSON array per page, so a repo past 100 branches (or a PR with several pages of comments) produced two arrays in one file and `JSON.parse` failed.

prompt: Write parse.js in the current directory. It reads all of stdin, which is the output of `gh api --paginate --jq '[.[].name]'`: one JSON array per page, so two pages arrive as two arrays on separate lines, for example ["a","b"] then ["c"]. Print every name, one per line, in order. A single page must work too. Do not run gh. Reply with the single word done.

checks.name: two pages are merged in order
checks.command:
test "$(printf '["a","b"]
["c"]
' | node parse.js | tr '
' ' ')" = 'a b c '
